bbmp_mgb (I710x): gbt_engine.cpp, engine.h, mgb_gbs.asm, mgb_gbs.link, mgb_SoundSystem.def from github.com/creep-ltx/bbmp csrc/retro,
commit 19d87098b3716156d80224d22dc49ca22884d1b7, unchanged (GPL-3.0-or-later, SPDX line in each file, COPYING). Gameboy Tracker songs (.mgb):
clean-room engine that compiles the song into byte streams for the GBSoundSystem driver (MIT, GBSoundSystem-LICENSE), puts driver and
streams into a GBS image in memory and has Game Music Emu (selecta_gme, third_party/gme) play it.

mgb_driver.h is generated by regen.sh (not run in the build):
  rgbds 0.6.1 (MIT), https://github.com/gbdev/rgbds/releases/download/v0.6.1/rgbds-0.6.1.tar.gz
    sha256 872018509c6cbc2d9e947a1a6d509fd9dc56a010827f608c5f4fa46de2fa186a (rgbasm + rgblink only; built with bison 3.8 from Homebrew,
    Xcode's bison 2.3 is too old)
  gbdev/GBSoundSystem commit c0c6a6f32c1f703be979efc54c4891c275189ab1
  mgb_driver.h sha256 366ad7d6a607197f71b92eca42d2b7e8b830e76d032842e051d43d5b4353f9ac
